interruption.label: PŘERUŠENÍ TOKU
interruption.reason: Registry bootstrap uses the Vite-inlined CSV string. Disk edits to public/house-package/gallery.csv do not update a running session until the ?raw module is invalidated/rebuilt. Static Network GET of /house-package/gallery.csv can show new bytes while UI still renders the previously inlined registry — this is the observed visual-review disconnect, not a return to manifest.json.
